llm.summary: This is a local Windows C-drive cleanup helper, but it needs Review because its cleanup powers are broader and less safely scoped than its “only move, never delete” promise.

dimensions.detail: Reading disk sizes and moving cache files is proportionate for disk cleanup, but scanning broad C-drive locations, modifying user folders, touching Program Files through compression, and running system servicing commands are higher-impact than expected for a novice cleanup assistant unless separated into tightly scoped advanced modes.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is local Markdown plus PowerShell scripts with no remote payload retrieval or dependency installation. The usage examples run PowerShell with ExecutionPolicy Bypass, which is common for local scripts but should still be visible to users.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill repeatedly requires user confirmation and defaults scripts to dry-run behavior, but the operational scope is under-defined: broad triggers such as “电脑卡” can activate it, safe_ops.ps1 allows unmatched paths by default, confirmed moves can proceed despite active process warnings, and WindowsClean delegates deletion choices to local cleanmgr profile 1 without enumerating the exact categories.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The habit.json preference file is disclosed and limited, but the skill also describes optional monthly automatic maintenance through a scheduled capability without clear task creation, disablement, or cleanup details. Admin-level DISM/CompactOS operations are disclosed in the workflow but not adequately bounded by the main safety model.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent with C-drive scanning, backup-drive selection, cache relocation, and user-confirmed cleanup. However, the artifacts also include recycle-bin moves, cleanmgr execution, NTFS compression of Program Files subtrees, DISM component cleanup, CompactOS, junction redirection, and user-profile file moves, which are high-impact operations that exceed the simple reversible move-only framing.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable reviewing each proposed cleanup item and declining advanced options. Do not run Program Files compression, DISM, CompactOS, cleanmgr automation, recycle-bin cleanup, or folder junction moves unless you understand the impact, have backups, and can restore the affected files. Prefer using the read-only scan first, and require exact source and destination paths before approving any move.
llm.findings:
[T09] unexpected: Accepted as material in part: artifact/scripts/safe_ops.ps1 has a fail-open Test-SafeToMove default, proceeds after process-lock warnings when -Confirmed is supplied, uses a shared dated backup destination with -Force, and invokes cleanmgr /sagerun:1 without showing the configured categories.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: recycle-bin moves, Windows Disk Cleanup, Program Files compression, DISM, and CompactOS are artifact-backed. They are disk-maintenance related, but they conflict with the advertised reversible “only move, never delete” model and should be reviewed separately.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted: the main instructions promise strict move-only recoverability while the workflow and script include non-move system cleanup and compression operations.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted as a secondary concern: triggers such as “电脑卡” and “腾空间” are broad for a filesystem-affecting skill, although confirmation gates reduce the risk of unintended modification.
[P2] expected: Downgraded: inspection showed the reported hidden character is a UTF-8 BOM at the start of the PowerShell files, not hidden agent instructions.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded for security adjudication: the Chinese-only content is consistent with the Chinese skill name, target copy, and audience framing; it is a locale/product-fit issue rather than evidence of unsafe behavior.
